label: Eager recomputation after every edit
subgoals: Find the downstream set of each edit separately
Recompute every result in each set as the edit lands
Sum the set sizes to get the eager evaluation count

label: Mark dirty, recompute on demand
subgoals: Flag every downstream result dirty at each edit
Take the union of the flagged sets
Recompute each dirty result once at query time

label: Early cutoff on unchanged values
subgoals: Re-evaluate the direct dependents of the edited node
Stop propagating at a result whose value comes out unchanged
Count only results reached along paths of changed values
